preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: for n, m, a, k, b in zip(n_list, m_list, a_list, k_list, b_list): 1 <= n <= 5*10**4 and 2 <= m <= 10**9 and len(a) == n and 1 <= k <= 5*10**4 and len(b) == k and all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a) and all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each test case has valid n, m, a, k, and b within specified ranges.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' if can_transform(ai, bi, mi) else 'No' for ai, bi, mi in zip(a_list, b_list, m_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'Yes' if it is possible to transform array a into array b using the given operations, otherwise 'No'.
